remarks: Must See! Completely reconstructed and extensively renovated!  Spacious 1600 sq. ft. ranch featuring 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and nearly 4 acres.  The home was extensively reconstructed and updated with new electrical, plumbing, duct work, windows, doors, flooring, insulation, New Electric Water Heater and central air.  Custom kitchen features European-style high-gloss Galaxy finish cabinetry, Samsung Smart appliances, and a large granite island.   100 sq. ft. of granite surfaces are featured throughout the home including the kitchen counter tops and island, fireplace, bar, both bathroom vanities and decorative bench in the office/gym area.   70 sq. ft. of slate stone accents are featured on the fireplace, bar, and decorative bench creating a distinctive custom finish.  Bathrooms feature fully tiled showers with glass doors, granite vanities and Fogless LED mirrors.  The interior features a stunning slate-stone electric fireplace in the living room.  The exterior has been extensively upgraded with a covered rear composite porch, professional landscaping, decorative stone, modern exterior lighting, and 400-500 sq. ft. of stained, sealed stamped concrete surrounding the front of the  home, designed to resemble natural ashlar stone.  The covered rear porch also features a 220V electrical hookup.  The property includes a fully renovated .detached 2-car garage with 110V/220V electrical service, new roof, siding, gutters, doors, and Wi-Fi enabled garage door openers with cameras.  A separate 300 sq. ft. fully renovated building with a full bathroom and electric heat provides excellent flexible space for an office, gym, studio, workshop or private recreational space.  Also included is a finished shed and a large professionally sealed driveway.  City water, septic and propane.  This exceptional property is move-in ready and has extensive upgrades, impressive finished space, custom finishes and exceptional versatility.  Furniture is negotiable.
